SECURITY INVARIANT: escalation deny must live in opencode POLICIES not permissions. Live-proven: permissions deny (any order) dies against a project-level allow (layers merge, last-match-wins) — sudo ran as root in both orders inside a project that allows everything. With global policies [{action:tool.use,resource:'shell:sudo *'},{...doas}] -> sudo from agent session = permission.rejected 'Blocked by configuration policy'. Global config carries: permissions allow-all (plain) + policies sudo/doas deny. Docs updated both repos (global-setup.md policies form; skea 57c8341, feralos a4e24c4+).
